# spx_vpc (Resource)

Manages a VPC on SPX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spx_vpc" "example" {
  name = "my-vpc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the VPC.

### Optional

- `az` (String) The availability zone of the VPC. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `orga_id` (String) The organization ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID. If not set, the provider value is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the VPC.
